<title>List of public corporations by market capitalization</title>
<fragment>
List of largest publicly traded companies

The following is a list of publicly traded companies having the greatest market capitalization. In the global business media, they are described as being the world's most valuable companies as a reference to their market value.[1]


Market capitalization is calculated from the share price (as recorded on selected day) multiplied by the number of outstanding shares.[2] Figures are converted into USD millions (using rate from selected day) to allow for comparison.[3]




## Trillion-dollar companies[edit]

**Companies that have ever reached a market‑capitalisation of $1 trillion USD (or more) – and the year they were founded**

| # | Company (ticker) | Year founded* | First date the market cap topped $1 trillion | Highest market‑cap ever recorded (≈) |
|---|-------------------|--------------|----------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Apple Inc.** (AAPL) | 1976 | 2 August 2018 | $3 trillion (Jan 2022) |
| 2 | **Microsoft Corporation** (MSFT) | 1975 | 18 October 2019 | $2.9 trillion (Oct 2023) |
| 3 | **Saudi Arabian Oil Co. (Saudi Aramco)** (2222.SR) | 1933 (as California‑Arabian Standard Oil Co.; renamed 1988) | 11 December 2019 | $2.9 trillion (May 2022) |
| 4 | **Alphabet Inc.** (GOOGL) – the Google holding company | 1998 (Google incorporated) | 17 January 2020 | $2 trillion (Oct 2023) |
| 5 | **Amazon.com, Inc.** (AMZN) | 1994 | 4 July 2020 | $1.9 trillion (Nov 2022) |
| 6 | **Meta Platforms, Inc.** (META) – formerly Facebook | 2004 | 4 July 2021 | $1 trillion (Oct 2021) |
| 7 | **Tesla, Inc.** (TSLA) | 2003 | 26 October 2021 | $1.2 trillion (Nov 2021) |
| 8 | **NVIDIA Corporation** (NVDA) | 1993 | 22 February 2023 | $1.2 trillion (Feb 2023) |

\* **Founding year** refers to the year the business was originally incorporated or officially launched.  
- For Saudi Aramco the earliest corporate origin is 1933; the “Saudi Aramco” name was adopted in 1988.  
- Alphabet became the parent holding company in 2015, but the underlying business (Google) was founded in 1998, which is the date most references use for the company’s origin.

### Quick notes

* **Apple, Microsoft and Saudi Aramco** are the only firms that have breached the **$2 trillion** mark (Apple and Microsoft have even touched $3 trillion).  
* **NVIDIA** is the most recent entrant (2023) and the only pure‑semiconductor company on the list.  
* **Meta** and **Tesla** have slipped below $1 trillion after their peaks, but they still qualify because they have **ever** surpassed the threshold.  

These eight companies represent the entire set of publicly‑traded entities that, at any point in history up to late 2024, have had a market capitalisation exceeding **$1 trillion USD**.
